baseline: Unmodified service/model/preferences snapshots copied from desktop original
diversityProtocol: All 30 UI combinations; budget 25000; any spiciness; 20 runs of 100 independent recommendations each; fresh preferences per run; current history advances one minute per draw; no session exclusions
randomness: Original List.shuffle() has no injected seed; original measurements vary between runs. Current uses seeds 20261013..20261032. Raw frequencies and per-run statistics are saved.
preferenceProtocol: Five synthetic rules; max 64 training menus; same like/dislike training IDs given to both algorithms; original favorites saved in mock SharedPreferences; current direct preferences plus learned model; sample whole 100-menu catalog 2000 times per scenario/policy/mode; no history update in this experiment. NOT held-out recommendation accuracy.
limitations: Local execution with mocked asset bundle and preferences, no real users/server. One dataset/budget/time interval. Current uses explicit traits also to score diversity. Synthetic preference figures are sampled menu proportions, not user satisfaction.
budgetSensitivityProtocol: Five budgets; each all 30 UI combinations; five runs of 50 recommendations per policy; cold start with one-minute exposure updates; independent from the 100-draw main experiment
